content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Panjab University Guest Faculty (Physical Education)
content_sections.text: Visit the official Panjab University website to access the application form for Assistant Professors (pages 1 to 9) via the provided link. Download and fill out the application form completely. Gather all your original certificates and relevant documents. Prepare two attested copies of all certificates and documents along with two passport-size photographs. Report directly to the Selection Committee Room (First Floor), Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh on 15 October 2026 at 3:00 PM for the walk-in interview with the filled application form and documents.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form (pages 1 to 9 from the PU website) Original certificates and relevant documents Two attested copies of all certificates and documents Two passport-size photographs

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Guest Faculty (Physical Education) Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The salary and qualification for the post will be as per Panjab University, Chandigarh / Pb. Govt. Norms. Candidates must give an undertaking that they will not draw any fellowship, stipend, or financial assistance from any agency while teaching as Guest Faculty at Panjab University Constituent College, Nihal Singh Wala (Moga). No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates must bring both original documents and two sets of attested copies.
